svg.title: All 12,769 input pairs of addition modulo 113
svg.desc: A 113 by 113 square. Column a and row b run from 0 to 112. Each cell is shaded by the answer (a+b) mod 113, dark for 0 and light for 112. The shade brightens from the top left corner to the anti-diagonal, snaps back to dark, and brightens again to the bottom right corner. The theorem covers every cell.
